notes.source: The memory page's words (#1428, ADR-0182 decision 6): what Nour remembers, the one switch over it, the export, and the two sentences a member reads when there is nothing and when a write failed. `frontend/ui/account/memory-view.tsx` is the reference and `android/.../account/MemoryScreen.kt` draws the same screen, so a label is read on both sides rather than retyped (ADR-0098, ADR-0103). The sentences the thread's menu shares live in `shared/copy/chat-thread.json`, because one key has one source. `ذاكرة نور` is this page's title only — the account row stopped carrying it when the assistant took that row (ADR-0224) — and it mirrors the assistant's name in `shared/copy/assistant-panel.json`: renaming the assistant touches both files.
notes.placeholders: `{text}` is the fact's own words, used only for the accessible labels so a button says what it acts on.
notes.gate: `npm run check:copy` fails a stale generated output, and `npm run check:parity` fails a key the view does not render or a state the app declares but does not draw.

strings.emptyHint: قل لي «تذكّر أنّ…» في المحادثة، أو اطلب مني أن أتذكّر شيئاً، وسيظهر هنا.
strings.settingsHint: إذا أوقفته لا أحفظ جديداً ولا أستدعي ما حفظته، ويبقى المحفوظ ظاهراً هنا حتى تنساه.
strings.exportHint: ملف تنزّله، فيه كل ما في هذه الصفحة.
